text:
anya: Heads-up: we started a rolling change to move quota enforcement to the edge router (so charge on finalization there) instead of origin. Saw customer bug: TS SDK users report duplicate estimated lines in console and some downstream infra alerting on spikes.

vikram: can you paste the diff of the router change? curious if we also changed any headers.

olivia: summary from infra: router now emits X-Quota-Decision: final|optimistic and will return X-Quota-Estimate on initial proxy accept. The intent: let edge validate quickly and let origin do the authoritative charge later when full token count known. We didn't intend to change client semantics.

mai: TS SDK user report: SDK pre-debits when it sees X-Quota-Estimate and assumes that equals eventual charge. When retry happens from client (network glitch) the SDK's local bucket has been decremented twice. Customer telemetry -> app-level metrics show a spike, console tenant totals align to final charge (so server is authoritative), but internal alerting triggered.

anya: that mismatch is causing support noise. ops wants a short-term mitigation + long-term fix.

tom: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) router echo back a stable request-id that survives retries (X-Edge-Request-Id) so SDK can dedupe, 2) add a header X-Quota-Mode: optimistic|authoritative so SDKs can opt into optimistic pre-debit only if router advertises it.

vikram: long-term: publish a formal quota contract doc and add a console flag to show both "client_estimates" and "server_charges" for a chosen window. Product wants that visible for ent accounts.

olivia: implementing X-Edge-Request-Id is trivial; we'll also add X-Quota-Mode in canary today.

mai: SDK changes: TS/py already have a quick toggle. Go SDK is trickier because we pre-debit in library code paths used by several downstream repos. We need a compatibility shim that honors X-Quota-Mode and X-Edge-Request-Id.

anya: propose immediate steps:
- router: enable X-Edge-Request-Id + X-Quota-Mode: optimistic in us-east canary now
- SDKs: default to conservative (no pre-debit) unless X-Quota-Mode == optimistic AND config.allowOptimisticPredebit == true
- console: show migration banner and a reconciliation view for 24h window
- telemetry: emit event quota.predebit.attempt and quota.duplicate_predebit when same Request-Id seen

tom: +1. Also add an internal compat header X-Quota-Compat: pre|post so we can ephemeral support older SDKs that ignore unknown headers.

vikram: we should also add a sanity test in the integration suite: simulate router optimistic estimate, then induce a client retry, assert server charged once and SDK local bucket handled dedupe.

mai: sample TS fix (pseudo):
```ts
// on response start
const est = resp.headers.get('x-quota-estimate')
const mode = resp.headers.get('x-quota-mode')
const edgeId = resp.headers.get('x-edge-request-id')
if (mode === 'optimistic' && config.allowOptimisticPredebit) {
  if (!localSeen.has(edgeId)) { localBucket.debit(est); localSeen.add(edgeId) }
}
// on finalization, if server charged and edgeId present -> reconcile
```

olivia: router will echo X-Edge-Request-Id on both initial accept and finalization. We'll also add X-Quota-Compat: optimistic for 48h.

tom: release coordination: can we coordinate canary windows so SDKs have time? I'd like at least 24h before making optimistic default.

anya: timeline suggestion:
- now: canary router emits headers (optimistic + edge-id) in us-east
- 24h: console reconciliation + telemetry dashboards live
- 48h: SDK patches cut and small patch releases (TS/Py fast-path, Go compatibility shim)
- 72h: revisit default mode and consider switching for more regions

ops-bot: canary deploy started (job 9912) - router headers enabled in us-east. ETA 8m.

vikram: PM asked to add a notice in the quota dashboard that clarifies "estimates may be optimistic until finalization". Also ask support to tag affected customers.

mai: I'll open PRs: ts-sdk PR (draft) and python PR. Go will get a compat PR with Config.AllowOptimistic and honoring X-Edge-Request-Id for dedupe.

olivia: I'll post router rollout notes and header contract in #eng-platform when canary completes.

anya: can someone own adding the integration test to sdk-integration-suite? That would've caught this earlier.

david (not in thread but pinged): I'll take the test. Will add a harness that fakes router behavior + mid-stream retry.

anya: great, thanks. keep this thread updated with PR links and console ticket. We'll loop in SRE and support after canary metrics look stable. :thumbsup:
